text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Splendidly done, my knight.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The feelings poured into your running...
I, Fine Motion,
have received them loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Just kidding♪

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me, Princess.
However—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Running with you made me realize once again.
This Durandal..."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: That she is still on the path of chivalry.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Underway...?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Yes...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I was fortunate enough to be blessed with victory today.
However...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Grace, mental fortitude, pride... In every internal aspect,
I am still far from matching you.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Running alongside you like this, feeling each and every firm stride...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Feeling the sheer gap between us...
I straightened my posture, determined
to live my life on a truer, straighter path.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I see... If I was able to give you anything,
then that makes me happier than anything.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I, the knight Durandal, remain in a position to seek your teachings. However...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: —I swear this oath to you. One day, I will become a true knight and stand beside you as an equal.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Durandal.
I'm looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Let's definitely run together again!
Once we've both gotten even stronger♪

The two were enveloped in refreshing applause.
And so the ball came to an end, but—

The story of the knight and the princess is not over yet.
Likely continuing on, even into next year.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono, I have returned.
Even after finishing the run...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"There is still a path I have yet to run to completion.
So that one day, my nobility will not pale in comparison to Fine-san's."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: And more than that—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"I want to prove that my King is someone
even more wonderful than Fine-san."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Those feelings... grew even stronger.
I shared the same feelings of master and servant. To one day make Durandal the greatest knight, and then—

I want to become a king worthy of the title too.
There is still a long road ahead.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Now then, my King. Regarding our next goal...
choice_data_list: The next one will naturally be next year.
Naturally, the next one will be next year.

text_block_list.text:
There are no more sprint GⅠs left this year.
Our next target will be held next spring...
choice_data_list: Let's go with the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
—Understood. A 1200m GⅠ, then.
We had concerns about sprints before, but...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"As I am now, I should be able to pull it off.
Even if Believe-san and Right O-san
don't show up."

And so, the goal was decided.
The first target race of the Senior Year is—

The sprint GⅠ, the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.
Let's sharpen the "Holy Sword" even further
before then.
